title: AI & Machine Learning — Beginner
description: Learn the foundations of AI/ML, Python for data work, and basic statistics.

sections.title: AI/ML Fundamentals
sections.description: Understand what AI and machine learning are and how they relate.
learning_objectives: Distinguish AI, ML, and deep learning

sections.title: Python for ML
sections.description: Learn the Python fundamentals needed for data science work.
learning_objectives: Write Python functions and control flow
Work with lists, dicts, and comprehensions
Use Python in a notebook environment

sections.title: NumPy Fundamentals
sections.description: Perform efficient numerical computing with NumPy arrays.

sections.title: Pandas Fundamentals
sections.description: Load, explore, and manipulate tabular data with Pandas.

sections.title: Statistics & Probability Basics
sections.description: Learn the statistical foundations used throughout ML.
learning_objectives: Compute measures of central tendency and spread

sections.title: Introduction to Supervised Learning
sections.description: Understand the basic idea of learning from labeled data.

title: AI & Machine Learning — Intermediate
description: Apply classical ML algorithms and evaluate models properly.

sections.title: Classical ML Algorithms
sections.description: Apply widely-used classical machine learning algorithms.

sections.title: Unsupervised Learning
learning_objectives: Understand dimensionality reduction at a conceptual level

sections.title: Model Evaluation
sections.description: Assess how well a model performs and generalizes.
learning_objectives: Use accuracy, precision, and recall appropriately

sections.title: Feature Engineering
sections.description: Create and transform features to improve model performance.

sections.title: Overfitting & Generalization
learning_objectives: Use validation curves to guide model complexity

sections.title: Introduction to Deep Learning
sections.description: Learn the basics of neural networks and deep learning.
learning_objectives: Explain the structure of a neural network
Understand forward and backward propagation conceptually

title: AI & Machine Learning — Advanced
description: Work with deep learning, transformers, and modern LLM/RAG application architecture.

sections.title: Neural Networks Deep Dive
sections.description: Understand advanced neural network architectures and training dynamics.
learning_objectives: Explain activation functions and their trade-offs
Understand optimizers and learning rate schedules

sections.title: Transformers
sections.description: Understand the architecture behind modern language models.

sections.title: Large Language Models
sections.description: Understand how LLMs are trained and used.
learning_objectives: Recognize LLM limitations and failure modes

sections.title: Embeddings
sections.description: Use embeddings to represent and compare data semantically.
learning_objectives: Explain how embeddings capture semantic similarity
Use embeddings for search and clustering
Choose an embedding strategy for a task

sections.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
sections.description: Build systems that ground LLM responses in external data.
learning_objectives: Evaluate and improve RAG system quality

sections.title: AI Application Architecture
sections.description: Design production applications powered by ML models and LLMs.
learning_objectives: Separate structured logic from model calls
Plan for evaluation, cost, and latency in AI features
